purpose: Content-addressed rebuttal precedent (owner-adopted 2026-11-04, v14-hold solution §2e). An entry links a finding fingerprint + cited path to the git blob the cited file had when the disposition was made. A later review classifies a matching finding as standing ONLY while the cited file's blob is unchanged; any edit to the file retires the precedent automatically and the finding is adjudicated fresh. Seeded with the five guard-minor dispositions sustained across review-v11..v14.

entries.blob_basis: git blob id at HEAD; the cited file's only touching commit is 1f4c38d — unchanged since before its first disposition

disposition.summary: Standing repeat [11]: Deterministic 'test disabled' rule hits the POSIX platform-guard line (unittest.skipUnless(os.name == 'posix', ...)) — a platform guard with its reason in the line itself, not a disabled test. Rebutted with executable evidence in review-v11-dispositions.md and recorded as a standing repeat in every round since; the guard is not removed, renamed, or scoped out.
